field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: All mandated models record exact local identity, bytes, tokenizer, context, CUDA placement, and eligibility.
field_principles.aa_noise_results_by_model: A/A duplicates catch nondeterministic replay and noise-only separation.
field_principles.actual_work_duration_receipt: Measured work time is reported without sleep padding.
field_principles.candidate_surface_inventory_by_model: The inventory shows hidden-state availability and fallback eligibility before selection.
field_principles.causal_intervention_results_by_model: Vulnerable/fixed controls must pass inside each model.
field_principles.claim_flip_pair_swap_label_permutation_e: Semantic and evaluator controls catch selection leakage and label shortcuts.
field_principles.cuda_and_gpu_offload_receipts_by_model: CUDA receipts prevent CPU or stub execution from becoming a headline claim.
field_principles.duration_padding_count: A bare zero proves no duration padding was used.
field_principles.duration_s: Measured wall time is separated from reproducibility content.
field_principles.field_principles: Each field states why it exists and what failure mode it guards.
field_principles.field_provenance: Every field traces to the prompt, spec, module, fixture, runtime, or tests.
field_principles.gpu_memory_before_peak_and_after_release: Memory receipts prove sequential load and release behavior.
field_principles.hidden_state_runtime_receipts_by_model: Hidden states are used only when tensor provenance exists.
field_principles.honest_verdict: The terminal verdict states ready or complete-null without broadening the claim.
field_principles.inference_substrate: The artifact declares the local GGUF representation preflight path.
field_principles.micro_fixture_path_and_hash: The tiny causal fixture is immutable and checked before model extraction.
field_principles.model_file_hashes_revisions_and_quantiza: File bytes, revisions, and quantization bind each surface to one local model.
field_principles.model_local_representation_surface_ready: Bare readiness is one only when all models and controls pass.
field_principles.models_used: The three mandated hub IDs are explicit and no legacy substitute can satisfy readiness.
field_principles.no_generation_receipt: The experiment must not generate answers or logits.
field_principles.no_shared_adapter_receipt: No cross-model adapter or pooled rescue is allowed.
field_principles.norm_length_truncation_duplicate_and_ide: Shortcut controls catch norm, length, truncation, duplicate, and model-identity artifacts.
field_principles.paper_source_and_local_claim_boundary: The paper motivates the probe idea but does not prove local GGUF tensor access.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Local resources are checked before model construction.
field_principles.prefix_trajectory_fallback_receipts_by_m: The fallback is output-free and preregistered when hidden states are unavailable.
field_principles.protected_files_unchanged: Protected conductor and ops files remain untouched by the preflight.
field_principles.random_seeds: Seeds make prefix ordering and deterministic backends replayable.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Stable checksum detects fixture, row, control, or provenance drift.
field_principles.selected_surface_by_model: The selected surface is one native model surface and is not pooled across models.
field_principles.source_model_weight_mutation_count: A bare zero proves model weights were not changed.
field_principles.status: Terminal state separates ready surfaces from clean null closure.
field_principles.surface_selection_rule: The hidden-first rule is frozen before labels are observed.
field_principles.surface_tensor_shapes_and_hashes: Shapes and hashes make raw row corpora replayable without storing them only in prose.
field_principles.test_commands: Commands bind the result to unit, coverage, full-suite, spec, and run checks.
field_principles.test_exit_codes: Exit codes prevent unchecked artifacts from becoming ready.
field_principles.tokenizer_hashes: Tokenizer receipts detect drift in the embedded GGUF tokenizer path.
field_principles.underpowered_or_missing_cells: Every missing precondition or failed control remains visible.
field_principles.upstream_failure_ledger: Prior V543 failures stay visible so this run cannot reuse a flagged shared bus.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: False because representation surfaces are features, not the exact code oracle.

activation_probes_reference.local_claim_boundary: The paper motivates model-local activation probes. It does not prove that this host's GGUF runtime exposes hidden tensors with provenance.
